name: GitHub data layer
tagline: Server functions between pages and GitHub
summary: Every page gets its GitHub data through one layer: typed queries in the browser, server functions on the Worker, and Octokit calls made with the right token for each repository.

flow.label: My pulls page
flow.note: The loader starts a prefetch without waiting; the page reads the same query.

flow.label: Query options
flow.note: Pairs a per-user query key with a server function and a stale time.

flow.label: getMyPulls server function
flow.note: Runs on the Worker, loads the session and builds a GitHub client for the viewer.

flow.label: Token routing
flow.note: Repo reads use the GitHub App installation token when it covers the repo, else the OAuth token.

flow.label: Dedup and timeout
flow.note: Identical reads in one request share a call; each call is cut off after 15 s.

flow.label: GitHub REST and GraphQL
flow.note: Octokit sends the request; its retry and throttle plugins are turned off.

features.name: Query keys and options
features.summary: 85 query-option factories share one key tree. Every key starts with the user id, so two accounts in one browser never share data.

features.name: Server functions
features.summary: 152 TanStack server functions in 29 modules, one per GitHub read or write. Most use REST; page bundles, my-work search and timelines use GraphQL.

features.name: Token routing
features.summary: Reads use the GitHub App installation token when the app covers the repo, else the OAuth token. Writes use the viewer's own token so GitHub credits them.

features.name: Installation token cache
features.summary: Installation tokens are minted from the app key, kept in memory and KV until 5 minutes before expiry, and dropped when an installation webhook arrives.

features.name: Request dedup
features.summary: Identical reads within one server request share a single GitHub call. Viewer and installation lookups are also remembered in memory for 30 seconds.

features.name: Timeouts and cancelling
features.summary: Each GitHub request stops after 12 s and each operation after 15 s (25 s for paged reads). Requests are cancelled when the browser gives up.

features.name: Error handling
features.summary: Failed writes come back as a plain message, with an install-the-app link on 403. Some 401 and 403 replies are flagged as needing GitHub re-authorization.
